name: Hyman Cannabis Mini Eclair Preroll | Dankaroos
description:
Twice infused. Twice enjoyed. Each Éclair blends premium flower (0.6g) with cold-cured, single-source rosin (0.1g), then finishes strong with a glass tip and H2O brushing for a smooth, even burn. Built to taste better and burn smarter.

Strain Type: Sativa

Flavors: Sour, Sweet, Vanilla 

Aromas: Sour, Pungent, Fruity

Experience: Uplifting, Giggly, Tingly
